ratings.notes: Honorable is an AuthorityVirtue and FairnessVirtue. Cunning can imply deceit (FairnessVice).
Brave can relate to self-sacrifice (Loyalty) or opposing oppressors (Liberty). Careful can relate to protecting from harm (Care).
Spiritual relates to PurityVirtue and MoralityGeneral.
Ferocious implies harm (HarmVice). Pacifist implies peace (HarmVirtue).
Both poles relate to hierarchical social interactions (Authority).
Forgiving relates to kindness (Care). Vengeful relates to harm (CareVice) and unfairness (FairnessVice).
